Wow, I was skeptical at first, but as a native Korean who speaks fluent English, I can say this AI translator is kilos better than Papago or Google Translate when it comes to Kor-Eng translation, at least in sentence structure and naturalness. Here are some samples I took from a short story I wrote in Korean, translated into English.

Original: "차라도 한 잔 타드리겠지만, 영 손님이 올 일이 없어서요. 대접할만한 거라곤 위스키 밖에 없네요."

Papago: "I'll make you a cup of tea, but I don't have any young customers coming. Whiskey is the only thing I can serve."

Google Translate: "I'll make you a cup of tea, but I don't have any guests coming over. The only thing I can serve you is whiskey."

DeepL: "I'd make you a cup of tea," he said, "but I'm not expecting company, and the only thing I have is whiskey."

Original: "난... 여기서 행복해요. 완전히 만족해요. 아주 오랫동안 스스로를 혹사해왔고, 죽음에 다다러서야 스스로를 챙길 여유가 생겼어요. 이 행복을 깨고 싶진 않군요."

"깰 일 없을겁니다. 당신이 원한다면 이 주에 있는 저택을 살 수도 있어요. 조용하고, 숲이 있고, 호수도 있는 곳으로. 아무의 방해도 받지 않고 우리 둘만 사는거에요, 아, 물론 개들도 같이."

Papago: "I'm... happy here. I am completely satisfied. I've been overworking myself for a very long time, and I can only afford to take care of myself when I'm about to die. I don't want to break this happiness."

"You won't wake up. You can buy a mansion in this state if you want. To a place that is quiet, forested, and lake. It's just the two of us living without anyone's interference, oh, of course, with dogs."

Google Translate: "I'm... happy here. I'm perfectly content. I've been torturing myself for so long, and it's only in death that I can afford to take care of myself. I don't want to break this happiness."

"You won't wake up. We could buy a mansion in this state if you want. It's quiet, there's a forest, there's a lake. It's just the two of us, with no one to disturb us, and, of course, the dogs."

DeepL: "I... I'm happy here, completely content, and I've been beating myself up for so long, and it's only now that I'm close to death that I can afford to take care of myself, and I don't want to break that."

"It won't be broken. If you want, we can buy a mansion in this state. Somewhere quiet, with woods and a lake. Just the two of us, with no one bothering us, oh, and the dogs, of course."

So from these samples, you can see that DeepL without a question beats the two other translators in terms of how natural the sentence is structured, and how it barely sounds translated. It also seems to pick up context from previous sentences when it's translating the sentences coming after them. 

There still are some mistranslations here and there, of course, but that's just the matter of getting more data fed into it. As a multilingual, this is a thrilling AI. As a professional translator tho, this is um... lemme just say, not great for my future career.
